claim: Liang et al. 2021 (npj Comput Mater 7:188) run a genuinely crossed grid of surrogate models (RF, GP with 5 kernel choices, GP-ARD) x acquisition functions (EI, PI, LCB) across 5 materials domains, but report results only via two custom descriptive ratio metrics (Enhancement Factor, Acceleration Factor) against a random-search baseline -- never an ANOVA, fANOVA, or eta-squared variance-attribution statistic.
stance_target: N6 near-miss confirmation: structural crossing present, statistical method (ANOVA) absent
scope_conditions: 5 experimental materials-science datasets: carbon nanotube-polymer blends, silver nanoparticles, lead-halide perovskites, additively manufactured polymer structures (Crossed barrel), plus a fifth
quoted_support: "We then pair the selected surrogate model with one of three acquisition functions, including expected improvement (EI), probability of improvement (PI), and lower confidence bound (LCB)... Enhancement Factor (EF) EF(i) = Top%_BO(i) / Top%_random(i) shows how much improvement in a metric one would receive at cycle i, and Acceleration Factor (AF) AF(Top%=a) = i_BO / i_random is the ratio of cycle numbers showing how much faster one could reach a specific value."

claim: Liang et al. 2021 explicitly frames Bayesian optimization as a closed-loop, online active-learning method operating in real experimental campaigns, not offline (fixed-dataset) model-based optimization.
stance_target: N6 near-miss confirmation: domain mismatch (online vs offline MBO)
quoted_support: "BO has been shown to be a data-efficient closed-loop active learning method for navigating complex design spaces... Fig. 2: Benchmarking framework including a simulation of BO performing closed-loop optimization with alternating inference and planning stages."

stance_target: N6 near-miss confirmation via exhaustive grep, disambiguating a potential false-positive lead ('crossed')

quoted_support: Grep counts: factorial=0, crossed=14 (all 'Crossed barrel dataset'), ANOVA=0, fANOVA=0, 'analysis of variance'=0, eta squared/eta-squared=0, two-way=0, main effect=0, interaction=0, OFAT=0, one-factor-at-a-time=0, offline=0, closed-loop=6, acceleration=12, enhancement=10.
